name: mscse-early-start-summer
description: Policy review round 3, P3-chg-other-1 (DGS 2026-10-05: “Apply handling (a)”). An MSCSE admit whose official matriculation is Fall 2026 starts early and takes CSE 60111 in Summer 2026 (A). Academic Code §3.6 treats a full-time admit who starts in the summer as a full-time student that summer, so the course is this program’s coursework: it counts, with no “dated before your entry term … check the entry term” line or warning. The clocks and residency still run from the fall (DGS 2026-10-03, 2026-10-04): the time limit is due before Fall 2031, and the summer is not a residence term.
